name: Printed PLA (solid)
note: Bambu Lab PLA Basic data sheet: 1.24 g/cm3 (ISO 1183), 2680 MPa along the layers (ISO 527). A panel is printed flat, so its bending runs along the layers. Price as the lab's PLA (Elegoo PLA Basic, 1 kg, $13.49). Loss factor: middle of Rothe et al. Table 7 for FFF PLA beams (same figure as catalog/materials.json pla).

source.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet

loss_factor_source.title: Rothe et al., Material Parameter Identification for Acoustic Simulation of Additively Manufactured Structures, Materials 14(1):168 (2021), Table 7
loss_factor_source.note: Frequency-independent identified loss factors η for six FFF PLA beams: 0.055 to 0.095; the record holds the middle, 0.075. Not measured on Bambu PLA.
